mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during GDP growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when unemployment is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Combined growth in employment and low unemployment indicates a strong economy, boosting S&P 500.
failure_condition: No positive correlation between employment growth and returns.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate and stable inflation indicate easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative during easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth indicates strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: No positive impact of production growth on returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when housing starts exceed 1500.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate with strong retail sales may signal inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive during tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment and high employment in late cycle may signal caution, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive in late-cycle with low unemployment.
